```{r, warning="FALSE", comment="", message=""}

## Libraries
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(phylopath)
library(nlme)

## Setting seed for data reproducibility
set.seed(5968)

# Simulating tree and trait data
n_species <- 30
tree <- compute.brlen(rtree(n_species))

Body_mass <- fastBM(tree)
Endothermy <- fastBM(tree)
Telomere_length <- 0.6 * Body_mass + fastBM(tree, sig2 = 0.5)
Lifespan <- 0.8 * Body_mass + fastBM(tree, sig2 = 0.5)

df <- data.frame(
  Body_mass = Body_mass,
  Telomere_length = Telomere_length,
  Lifespan = Lifespan,
  Endothermy = Endothermy,
  row.names = tree$tip.label
)

# Defining model DAG
model_seven <- DAG(
  Telomere_length ~ Body_mass,
  Lifespan ~ Body_mass,
  Endothermy ~ 1
)

# Fitting model with phylopath
res <- phylo_path(
  model_set = list(model_seven = model_seven),
  data = df,
  tree = tree,
  model = "BM"
)

# Extracting unstandardized estimates
fit_path <- choice(res, "model_seven", standard = "none")
cat("PHYLOPATH RESULTS \n")
print(fit_path$coef)

# Reproducing phylopath results with nlme::gls
df$species <- rownames(df)
pgls_telomere <- gls(
  Telomere_length ~ Body_mass,
  data = df,
  correlation = corBrownian(1, phy = tree, form = ~species)
)
pgls_lifespan <- gls(
  Lifespan ~ Body_mass,
  data = df,
  correlation = corBrownian(1, phy = tree, form = ~species)
)
cat("\nDIRECT GLS RESULTS: Telomere_length ~ Body_mass \n")
print(summary(pgls_telomere)$tTable)
cat("\nDIRECT GLS RESULTS: Lifespan ~ Body_mass \n")
print(summary(pgls_lifespan)$tTable)
```
